verdicts.summary: [L] states no counterpart of what [M] prints.
evidence: [M] prints, for r<=2, a strip trace-norm bound on P_mu^3, block bounds on D^r P_mu, and per-order bounds ||D^r(A_mu^{-1})||_{dual->primal} <= Q_r(C) and ||mu^2 D^r(A_mu^{-1})||^bl <= Q_r(C) for the joint/folded operator A_mu, plus insertion bounds. The claim that [L] has none of these is too strong: thin_doubled gives `bags (Slab.basic _) (Slab.basic _) p p (furnish L (fun q => damp (inch L) q^3 • 1) p) (...)` (a trace-duality bound on the free P_mu^3 on strip 1/128) and pebbles_frozen gives `Charges ... (pebFilm E) σ (mealPeb ...)` (r<=2 derivative bounds on P_mu); Freezer.back and Jam.rebounds carry the Q_r algebra (C, C^2 A, 2C^3A^2+C^2A) only generically and conclude with one combined constant. No declaration states the Q_r inverse bounds for A_mu (Freezer.back is applied only to the pebble film; honored/GrantF give only an r=0 Freezer for the inverses) nor the mu^2-scaled block bounds or the insertion bounds, so the finding no-match stands with those claims missing.

[M] prints, for the field-dependent operators at background U, sup over the strip of ||P_mu(xi)^3||_1 <= C^ins, block-norm bounds ||D^r P_mu||^bl <= C^ins, ||D^r(A_mu^{-1})||_{dual->primal} <= Q_r(C^ins) and ||mu^2 D^r(A_mu^{-1})||^bl <= Q_r(C^ins) for r<=2, plus insertion bounds. [L] has only ingredients: uniform_backing concludes `(jointInverse G P K B).strip η A` and an inverse identity (no derivatives, no trace norm, no mu^2 scaling); Jam.rebounds/Fiesta.inv are abstract one-parameter matrix lemmas bounding r^i*vflux(jarY i X^{-1}) by inverseBill A C / a (which contains the Q_r shape B, A B^2, 2A^2B^3+B^2A) but are never instantiated to A_mu with block/dual-primal norms; terrain_min is only the scalar mass-floor inequality (eq:B-mass-floor) from the proof. No declaration states a trace-norm bound on P_mu^3 or derivative bounds on P_mu, so the claim stands.
